verdict.rationale: Reducto Studio is a first-party web workspace where developers configure parsing and extraction steps, test them on real documents with a citation viewer, and only then deploy as a Pipeline ID callable from code. That matches the story of seeing results before writing code. Community users describe Studio as having great UX; one report of a broken launch link is an access glitch, not evidence the playground fails to work. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of drag-and-drop upload, detailed playground walkthrough docs, independent hands-on corroboration of viewing parse/extract output.

support.subject: As a developer, I drag a document into a web playground and see parse/extract results before writing any code

citations.quote: Build document workflows by configuring classification, parsing, extraction, and editing steps, test on real documents with the citation viewer, then deploy as a Pipeline ID callable from code.
Up to 5 seats for Reducto Studio
